newsitem.title: USA: Massport coming to market with $120 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Massport coming to market with $120 mln bonds.

text.p: Massport, the operating agency for Boston's Logan airport, is planning a $120 million revenue bond offering next week, an official for the independent state authority said Friday.
Merrill Lynch & Co will be running the books on the deal and J.P. Morgan Securities Inc will be co-senior manager.
The issue is expected to come to market Thursday.

MBIA Insurance Corp will insured the entire issue, which will be back by the revenues from seven airlines that have formed a corsortium called BosFuel, said Massport spokesman Jeremy Crawford. BosFuel is a Delaware incorporated company that will lease and operate the new fueling facility that proceeds from the bond issue will fund.
Boston-based Palmer & Dodge is acting as disclosure counsel on the deal and Ropes & Gray is bond counsel.
